Analyze and Plot Specified Species Data Ranked by Country Production

Source: R/species_country.R
species_country.Rd

This function takes a data frame and a specified species name, analyzes the data for the specified species, and identifies the top countries based on production within the specified rank range.

Usage

species_country(
  area_data,
  species_name,
  rank_range = c(1, 10),
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  timeseries_analysis = TRUE,
  h_value = 0.15,
  polygon_color = "grey90",
  fill_scale = NULL,
  axis_title_face = "bold",
  axis_title_size_map = 14,
  axis_text_size_map = 12,
  legend_text_size_map = 12,
  strip_text_face = "bold",
  axis_text_size = 10,
  axis_title_size = 12,
  strip_text_size = 12,
  ZH = FALSE,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE)
)

Arguments

area_data

A data frame containing the fishing area data.

species_name

A string specifying the species to be analyzed.

rank_range

A numeric vector of length 2 specifying the rank range of countries to be analyzed.

plot

A logical value indicating whether to generate and save plots.

table

A logical value indicating whether to generate and save tables

timeseries_analysis

A logical value indicating whether to analysis timeseries.

h_value

The minimum segment size passed to strucchange::breakpoints(): a fraction of the series length (default 0.15) or a number of years.

polygon_color

The color of the borders of the polygons in the map plot. Default is "grey90".

fill_scale

The colour palette of the map. Default is NULL, which uses map_palette of fao_settings() ("deep-orange" unless changed); see ?fao_settings for the choices.

axis_title_face

The font face of the axis title. Default is "bold".

axis_title_size_map

The size of the axis title text in the map plot. Default is 14.

axis_text_size_map

The size of the axis text in the map plot. Default is 12.

legend_text_size_map

The size of the legend text in the map plot. Default is 12.

strip_text_face

The font face of the strip text. Default is "bold".

axis_text_size

The size of the axis text. Default is 10.

axis_title_size

The size of the axis title text. Default is 12.

strip_text_size

The size of the strip text. Default is 12.

ZH

A logical value. If TRUE, chart text and names are in Chinese. Default is FALSE. ZH = TRUE is the same as lang = "zh".

lang

The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or "both" (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses "zh" if ZH = TRUE, and otherwise the language set with fao_settings() ("en" unless changed).

pptx

A logical value. Charts are always saved as PNG in figures/png/; if TRUE they are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in figures/pptx/. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with fao_settings(pptx = TRUE).

Value

A data frame with the yearly catch of the species by the ranked countries (the others grouped); with timeseries_analysis = TRUE, a list of this data frame and the periods between breakpoints of each country. Charts and tables are saved if plot and table are TRUE.

See also

Other species and country analyses: country_analysis(), country_species()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
species_country(FAO34[["area_data"]], species_name = "European pilchard(=Sardine)",c(1, 10), plot=TRUE,table=TRUE,h_value = 0.15) #area_data=Fao34
} # }
